paraphrase: King Yama asks the evil-doer whether he did not see the divine messengers — an infant, an old person, a sick person, a criminal being punished, a corpse — and reminds him that his evil deeds were done by himself, not by mother, father or gods; the hell-wardens then lead him through the hells.
